answer.reason: The Post content model (ID 11) is the blog/article model on instance 275bb356-d. It already has the fields the request needs: Heading, Slug, PostDate, a Category dropdown linked to the Category model, an Author dropdown linked to the Author model, Tags, rich-text Content, and an Image.
